  1. Show HN: Carton Clock – A working pendulum clock made from empty drink cartons

    • DIY

    88 points · 3 comments · 13 Nov 2026, 12:00 (Europe/London) · HN discussion

    Story — Carton Clock is a working pendulum clock built mainly from empty drink cartons, skewers, paper straws, string, weights, and hot glue. The project says it displays seconds, minutes, and hours and runs for a little over an hour when wound.

    Discussion — The brief thread praised the construction, asked about replaceable parts and cardboard gears, and noted the author’s accepted 40C3 talk. The author disclosed that design tools for gears and jigs were AI-assisted.
